en-US.description: A modern Rust/Tauri desktop frontend for watching Twitch streams via Streamlink.
en-US.name: Stream GUI RS
en-US.releaseNotes:
Stream GUI RS 1.10.0
Changes since Stream GUI RS 1.9.0.
This feature release adds a tray submenu for starting followed live channels and makes opening Watching on launch optional.
Features
- Added a Live channels submenu to the tray/menu-bar menu (#121, #119). With live monitoring on, it lists up to 25 followed Twitch channels from the latest complete check. Choosing one starts playback exactly like Watch, using the current player, quality, channel and chat preferences, and leaves the window as it was; a failure restores the window and shows the error. The submenu says when monitoring is off or paused, when you are signed out, while checking, and when the list is unavailable or may be outdated. It uses the existing monitor checks and makes no additional Twitch requests.
- Added Settings → Playback → Open Watching when starting a stream (#120, #118). It is on by default. When off, starting a Twitch, Kick or YouTube stream keeps the current view and announces success or failure there; Watching remains available from its button, which shows the active-session count, and its keyboard shortcut.
Tests
- Strengthened several test contracts, covered the local-window permission boundary for every registered command and removed duplicate checks (#116).
Dependencies
- Refreshed the npm lockfile, updating parse5 from 8.1.0 to 8.1.1 (#113).
- Refreshed both lockfiles (#115), including wry 0.57.1 → 0.57.2, webbrowser 1.2.6 → 1.2.7, uuid 1.29.1 → 1.29.2, rustls-pki-types 1.15.1 → 1.16.0 and webpki-root-certs 1.0.11 → 1.0.12. The test-only tldts-core moved from the deprecated partial release 7.4.20 to 7.4.19.
- Updated the anthropics/claude-code-action workflow digest (#114).
Upgrade and platform support
Settings move from schema 12 to schema 13 when settings are next saved; existing values are unchanged and Open Watching when starting a stream starts on, so launches behave as before. Upgrade without signing out or clearing settings. Older versions reject the schema 13 settings file without overwriting it.
Streamlink 8.0+ and a separately installed player remain required. Package formats remain Windows x86_64 installer and portable/Scoop ZIP; Linux x86_64 AppImage, DEB and RPM; and a universal macOS DMG for Apple Silicon and Intel requiring macOS 11.0 or later. Verify downloads against the accompanying SHA-256 files.
